knowledge:
- key_parameters: use_cache=logical indicating whether to cache downloaded KEGG files ;; directory=character path to local directory containing pre-downloaded KGML XML files ;; how=character ("any" or "all") specifying how to match query IDs in highlight_set_nodes() ;; layout=character layout style for ggraph (e.g., "manual" to use KEGG coordinates, or "nicely" for igraph layouts)
- alternatives: pathview=preferred for rendering user-defined values directly onto static KEGG maps ;; KEGGlincs=preferred for overlaying LINCS data and exporting to Cytoscape ;; graphite=preferred for converting pathways to graphNEL format for topological analysis ;; KEGGgraph=preferred for basic parsing of KEGG pathways into R-analyzable graph formats
- when_to_use: when you want to perform tidy graph manipulations on KEGG pathways using tidygraph and dplyr ;; when you need highly customizable, grammar-of-graphics-based visualizations of KEGG pathways, modules, or networks ;; when you want to overlay custom omics data (e.g., expression levels, centrality metrics) onto KEGG pathway topologies
- pitfalls: default graphics_name values in KGML files are often truncated, requiring convert_id() for clean gene symbols ;; when using non-manual layouts (e.g., "nicely"), node coordinates x and y must be set to NULL to prevent ggraph from using the default KEGG coordinates ;; ensure the correct organism prefix (e.g., "hsa" for Homo sapiens) is specified when converting IDs

workflows.name: kegg_pathway_analysis_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Parse a KEGG pathway, calculate network centralities, convert gene identifiers, highlight specific nodes, and visualize the pathway using ggraph.
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve and parse the KEGG pathway into a tbl_graph object ;; 2. Calculate node centrality metrics ;; 3. Convert gene identifiers to official symbols ;; 4. Highlight specific nodes of interest ;; 5. Visualize the pathway using manual coordinates, custom layouts, or raw map overlays
workflows.code:
graph <- ggkegg::pathway("hsa04110", use_cache=TRUE)
graph |> 
    mutate(degree=centrality_degree(mode="all"),
        betweenness=centrality_betweenness()) |> 
    activate(nodes) |>
    filter(type=="gene") |>
    arrange(desc(degree)) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    relocate(degree, betweenness)
graph <- graph |> mutate(showname=strsplit(graphics_name, ",") |>
                    vapply("[", 1, FUN.VALUE="a"))

ggraph(graph, layout="manual", x=x, y=y)+
    geom_edge_parallel(aes(color=subtype_name),
        arrow=arrow(length=unit(1,"mm"), type="closed"),
        end_cap=circle(1,"cm"),
        start_cap=circle(1,"cm"))+
    geom_node_rect(aes(fill=I(bgcolor),
                      filter=type == "gene"),
                  color="black")+
    geom_node_text(aes(label=showname,
                      filter=type == "gene"),
                  size=2)+
    theme_void()
graph |> mutate(x=NULL, y=NULL) |>
ggraph(layout="nicely")+
    geom_edge_parallel(aes(color=subtype_name),
        arrow=arrow(length=unit(1,"mm"), type="closed"),
        end_cap=circle(0.1,"cm"),
        start_cap=circle(0.1,"cm"))+
    geom_node_point(aes(filter=type == "gene"),
                  color="black")+
    geom_node_point(aes(filter=type == "group"),
                  color="tomato")+
    geom_node_text(aes(label=showname,
                      filter=type == "gene"),
                  size=3, repel=TRUE, bg.colour="white")+
    scale_edge_color_viridis(discrete=TRUE)+
    theme_void()
graph |>
    activate(nodes) |>
    mutate(hsa=convert_id("hsa")) |>
    filter(type == "gene") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    relocate(hsa)
graph |>
    activate(nodes) |>
    mutate(highlight=highlight_set_nodes("hsa:7157")) |>
    ggraph(layout="manual", x=x, y=y)+
    geom_node_rect(aes(fill=I(bgcolor),
                      filter=type == "gene"), color="black")+
    geom_node_rect(aes(fill="tomato", filter=highlight), color="black")+
    geom_node_text(aes(label=showname,
                      filter=type == "gene"), size=2)+
    geom_edge_parallel(aes(color=subtype_name),
                   arrow=arrow(length=unit(1,"mm"),
                               type="closed"),
                   end_cap=circle(1,"cm"),
                   start_cap=circle(1,"cm"))+
    theme_void()
graph |>
    mutate(degree=centrality_degree(mode="all")) |>
    ggraph(graph, layout="manual", x=x, y=y)+
        geom_node_rect(aes(fill=degree,
                      filter=type == "gene"))+
        overlay_raw_map()+
        scale_fill_viridis_c()+
        theme_void()

workflows.name: kegg_module_visualization
workflows.intent: Parse a KEGG module and visualize it using text-based or network-based representations.
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve and parse the KEGG module ;; 2. Generate a text-based module visualization ;; 3. Generate a network-based module block visualization
workflows.code:
mod <- module("M00002", use_cache=TRUE)
mod |>
    module_text() |> ## return data.frame
    plot_module_text()
mod |>
    obtain_sequential_module_definition() |> ## return tbl_graph
    plot_module_blocks()

workflows.name: quick_wrapper_visualization
workflows.intent: Quickly generate a ggraph visualization of a KEGG pathway, module, or network using the wrapper function.
workflows.stages: 1. Call the ggkegg wrapper function to automatically generate and return a ggraph plot object
workflows.code:
ggkegg("bpsp00270") |> class() ## Returns ggraph
ggkegg("N00002") ## Returns the KEGG NETWORK plot
